In mice bearing HR+ tumors that had been treated with fulvestrant plus FMD, reintroduction of insulin, leptin, and IGF1 (collectively referred to as fasting-reduced factors [FRFs]) resulted in increased tumor growth, indicating a reversal to the benefit of adding FMD to potentiate fulvestrant activity.
